This directory retains six unmodified files from VolkerMuehlhaus/lumpedmodel,
revision e92d2f0a8c7dbf057ae6fb382894dccfa1fb6320. Original paths and byte identities
are recorded in SOURCE.json. Files are renamed only as recorded there.

The upstream repository supplies the GNU General Public License, version 3,
retained verbatim as LICENSE. Preserve it and upstream attribution with these
files. The separate upstream fitter source (not copied into this fixture) says
Copyright (C) 2026 Volker Muehlhaus and GPL version 3 or later.
The authored reader/audit is separate work; retaining this fixture does not
relicense other project files.

The raw S3P is documented upstream as one Palace-simulated IHP SG13G2
center-tapped inductor, not a measurement. The fitted SPICE file uses p1, p2, ct
and global node 0. It exposes no independent body terminal, geometry parameters
or temperature/current/voltage qualification. Its 10 MHz to 60 GHz sample band
is not an operating or reliability limit. The original Palace geometry,
de-embedding, mesh convergence and measurement uncertainty are not supplied
by this selected fixture.
